title: Action de Galois sur Teichmüller : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (continuing pp. 56–57). U_{0,3} = P^1(C) − {0,1,∞} is viewed as a sphere cut by the real circle into two hemispheres. The hemisphere centres are P_+ and P_- (presumably e^{±iπ/3}). Q_i is the real point at the middle of the real arc opposite the puncture i; for example Q_∞ = 1/2, which is fixed by σ_∞: z ↦ 1−z and by complex conjugation τ.

This is the barycentric subdivision of the 'double triangle' map: vertices are the punctures, edge midpoints are the Q_i, face centres are P_±. The extended symmetry group Γ_0 = S_3 × {1,τ} has order 12. It acts simply transitively on the 12 flags, which Grothendieck calls 'repères' v = (i, ω, ε): a puncture or edge label i, an orientation ω of the equator, and a hemisphere ε = ω∧ϖ.

On p.57 he defined, for base points P_ε, the identifications ψ_r: Π_{0,3} = π_1(U_{0,3}; P_+) → π_1(U; P_ε). He proved the cocycle rule ψ_{rg_0} = ψ_r ∘ π_1(g_0) and made it explicit for ρ (order 3) and σ_∞.

This page does the same with the real base points Q_i. For v = (i, ω, ε), let u_v ∈ Γ_0 be the unique symmetry carrying the standard flag (∞, ω_0 = +1, ϖ_0 = +1, hence ε = +1) to v. Then ψ_i^{ω,ε} := π_1(u_v; Q_∞) maps π_1(U; Q_∞) to Π_i = π_1(U; Q_i). The source π_1(U; Q_∞) is identified with Π_{0,3} = π_1(U; P_+) via a standard path d_∞^+ from P_+ to Q_∞ (marginal NB).

For fixed i, the pinnings ('épinglages') ψ_i^{ω,ε} differ from one another by composition with the stabiliser of the base flag point in Γ_0. This stabiliser is ≅ Z/2 × Z/2, generated by σ_∞ and τ. One gets ψ_{vg_0} = ψ_v ∘ π_1(g_0; Q_∞), because u_{vg_0} = u_v ∘ g_0 by simple transitivity.

It therefore suffices to compute the automorphisms of Π_{0,3} induced by σ_∞ and τ. These are genuine automorphisms at the real base point Q_∞, transported to P_+ by d_∞^+. The next page gives the result: ψ_i^{ω,ε'} = τ∘ψ = ψ∘τ_∞, ψ_i^{ω',ε'} = σ_i∘ψ = ψ∘σ_∞, and composing these. The page then announces a switch to base points R_i^ω near the punctures, to see the monodromy around the holes directly.

Purpose: careful bookkeeping of base points and pinnings for the action of Γ_0 (and ultimately of Gal(Q̄/Q), which acts compatibly at rational and real base points) on the profinite fundamental group of P^1 − {0,1,∞}. This is the foundation of 'Galois action on Teichmüller' / GT.
errors: Base-point labels are inconsistent. The standard flag has i = ∞ and ψ is π_1(u_v; Q_∞), so u_v should send Q_∞ to Q_i (and Q_0 to Q_{ωi}), not 'Q_0 en Q_i, Q_1 en Q_{ωi}'. Likewise the stabiliser generated by σ_∞ and τ is the stabiliser of Q_∞ (= 1/2), not of Q_0. The next page indeed uses σ_∞, τ_∞, consistent with Q_∞.
Minor: τ does not fix P_+, so the 'action of τ on Π_{0,3} = π_1(U; P_+)' only makes sense through the real base point Q_∞ and the path d_∞^+. The text does handle this correctly via the marginal NB.

ideas.what: The 12 'repères' (flags of the double-triangle map on the sphere) form a Γ_0 = S_3 × Z/2 torsor; base-point identifications are indexed by flags, with a cocycle rule ψ_{vg} = ψ_v ∘ π_1(g).
ideas.modern_name: flags of a regular map / cartographic group acting simply transitively on flags; groupoid of base points
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (cartes, groupe cartographique, choice of base points)

ideas.what: Use of real base points (midpoints Q_i of the real arcs) stable under complex conjugation and the transpositions, so that the symmetries act by actual automorphisms rather than outer automorphisms of π_1.
ideas.modern_name: real/rational (tangential) base points; lifting the S_3 outer action to automorphisms of the profinite free group
ideas.where_published: Esquisse alludes to base-point choices; no detailed published computation

ideas.what: Pinnings ('épinglages') ψ_i^{ω,ε} of π_1 at the various base points relative to the standard one.
ideas.modern_name: fundamental groupoid with several base points

deep.surprise_reason: Routine base-point bookkeeping for the S_3 × {1,τ} symmetries of P^1 − {0,1,∞}, of the kind that underlies GT/Ihara–Drinfeld and is standard today. No new result or connection is visible on this page.
transcription_corrections: The first line likely reads 'la définition des ψ_v = ψ_i^{ω,ε} : Π_{0,3} → Π_i' with a struck-out word.
'Γ_0 = 𝔖_3 × {1,τ}' is correct; the group generated is ≃ Z/2 × Z/2.
'On sait que ces gestes' is probably 'On sait que ces gestes/germes'; the ending is uncertain.
